senses.en_definition: Early; before the usual, expected, or appointed time, or before others.
The beginning or opening part of a story, process, or other thing.
The beginning or early part of a period of time.

messages.en: Can we head out a bit earlier tomorrow? I don't want to get stuck in traffic again.
Sure. I'll pick you up at your place at seven. Will you be ready by then?
Yep, I'll be ready and waiting downstairs.
Let's just take public transport into the city centre later.
Sure. I've checked, and there's an MRT station really close to the place.
Amir, careful! The floor over there is slippery—it's just been mopped!
Oh, that explains it. I'll just go round the other side, then. Thanks!

senses.en_definition: Father; dad. Also used to address one's father or by a father to refer to himself when speaking to his children.
(dated) An Indian nanny or female domestic servant who looks after children.

messages.en: Dad, are you home yet? I want to come home now.
Yes, I'm home. Wait outside the school, okay? I'll come and pick you up in a bit.
Okay, I'll wait by the guardhouse.
